payload.text: The English translation of Table 5-1 (Appendix B) departs materially from the governing Arabic text (Appendix A). (1) Height reference: the Arabic says natural ground level before grading and filling; the English says finished ground level after grading and filling. (2) Scope: Arabic note 1 applies the limits to permanent AND temporary structures, including cranes and construction equipment; English note (1) covers permanent structures including stacks only. On the Arabic text, cranes and construction plant in Zone A are limited to 25 m above natural ground. The design, the crane/lifting plan (ADD-03 Q21) and the Section 7.3 notification should follow the Arabic text.

The Proposal Due Date of 26 November 2026 (in force at ADD-02) is not moved by another ADD-03 provision; this batch found no change to Volume I Clause 6.1 in ADD-03, but other ADD-03 provisions belong to other batches.
The Arabic readings of the Appendix A image (ADD-03:p4-image/*) are pending approval; the Arabic wording relied on here is that pending reading, which I checked against the image in this session.

Because the Arabic text governs (F2), the Table 5-1 limits are to be read as measured from natural ground level before grading/filling and as applying to temporary structures, cranes and construction equipment as well as permanent structures. This is more onerous than the English translation (e.g. any crane in Zone A limited to 25 m above natural ground).
Sections 7.3 and 7.4 are free-standing bid-stage obligations of the addendum itself that amend no volume unit; they are held as new register rows on the addendum units.
